name: Disconnector
summary: A switching device providing an electrical isolation function.
description: A disconnector, often called an isolator, provides an isolation function in an electrical circuit. Its representation should be read with the drawing legend and the selected device specification. Do not infer load-breaking or fault-interruption capability simply because a drawing contains a switch-like mark.

In a switchgear SLD the disconnector may appear next to a breaker, earthing switch or bus section. Control drawings can also show position indications and interlocking. The main-circuit representation and the auxiliary indications describe different parts of the equipment.
readingNotes: Identify which circuit segment is isolated by the device.
Distinguish the main switching function from its auxiliary position contacts.
drawingChecklist: Link the selected device and its isolation capability.
Reference the position indication and interlock documentation.
Show associated earthing arrangements where applicable.
distinction: A load-break switch has a specified load-switching capability. A disconnector designation alone does not establish that capability.
